name: 84123 · Salt Lake Cty, UT
findings: ZIP 84123 (Salt Lake Cty) has 85 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84123 (Salt Lake Cty) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 84123 (Salt Lake Cty) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.text: 5 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
